blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum homeostasis parhenge. Hum thermoregulation (jism ka darja-e-hararat qaboo mein rakhna) aur osmoregulation (jism mein pani aur namak ka tawazun rakhna) ke tareeqe dekhenge, aur yeh samjhenge ke insaan ki sehat aur zindagi ke liye homeostasis qaim rakhna kyun zaroori hai.

Homeostasis ek bohat zaroori amal hai jis ke zariye jandar apna andar ka mahol (internal environment) ek jaisa aur mustahkam (stable) rakhte hain, chahe bahar ka mahol badalta rahe. Homeostasis mein bohat se tareeqe (mechanisms) shamil hain jo mil kar jism ke andar ke mahol ko qaboo (regulate) karte hain. Homeostasis ke aham amal yeh hain: thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion (jism se fuzlaat yaani waste nikalna).

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi istilah thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion teeno ko shamil karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Homeostasis: teeno andaruni mahol ko mustahkam rakhte hain.

items: Homeostasis = bahar ka mahol badle tab bhi andar ka mahol ek jaisa rakhna.
Is ke aham amal: thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion.
